title: Chain rule in rotated coordinates: D(ζ ∘ a)(x) = ⟨q(graphPoint (∇ζ(a(x))) 0), ·⟩
statement: Let n, l ∈ N, let q be a linear isometry of R^{n+l}, ζ : R^n → R and x ∈ R^{n+l}. Write a(y) := (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q^{-1} y)).1 ∈ R^n, and assume ζ is differentiable at a(x). Then y ↦ ζ(a(y)) has Fréchet derivative at x equal to the continuous linear functional v ↦ ⟨q(graphPoint (∇ζ(a(x))) 0), v⟩ (innerSL ℝ of that vector; ∇ = gradient).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (ζ : Rn n → ℝ) (x : Amb n ℓ), DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm x)).1 → HasFDerivAt (fun y : Amb n ℓ => ζ (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm y)).1) (innerSL ℝ (q (graphPoint (gradient ζ (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm x)).1) 0))) x
